verdict.summary: Issue #217 at version 483ca4f5fc0c8b98d8428755eb11969c34cc6df029d4a5a26ee70fdd5de27f1c is not implementation-ready. Its scope, failure boundaries, validation, and rollout are substantially defined, but owner authorization, dependency evidence, and required control-plane state remain unresolved.

blockingFindings.title: Required owner decisions remain unresolved
blockingFindings.details: The contract explicitly blocks implementation and release publication pending authenticated owner answers for O217-1 through O217-7. These decisions determine implementation ownership, the supported platform matrix, the default logical-tier request, release signing and trust policy, stale-launcher migration, manifest freshness, and archive admission. The truncated owner comment does not resolve any decision, and no worker or contributor text can supply owner authorization.

blockingFindings.title: Blocking dependency chain is not satisfied or revision-proven
blockingFindings.details: The corrected contract requires #253, #260, and #275 to be merged on their default branches with green required checks and exact consumed revisions bound to #217 validation. Verified state shows #253 and #275 remain open. Although #260 is closed and its body claims to close #253, the still-open #253 state is inconsistent and no exact merged revisions, ancestry, required-check evidence, or consumption binding is supplied. CLI/TUI implementation and release integration therefore remain blocked.

blockingFindings.title: Required GitHub policy label is missing
blockingFindings.details: The exact issue version declares that unresolved owner decisions require labels P1 and df:ask-owner and prohibit df:reviewed. Verified target state contains only P1. The durable control-plane state therefore disagrees with the contract and trusted label policy; the issue cannot be review-clean until the exact current version is revalidated and df:ask-owner is applied.

nonBlockingNotes: O217-1 asks the owner to identify the exact canonical manager repository and package or gitlink path, plus any authorized child repositories.
O217-2 asks the owner to approve every initial OS, architecture, shell, artifact, per-user installation directory, PATH entry, and CI-runner matrix row.
O217-3 asks the owner to choose the default logical-tier request or require explicit tier selection while medium/Kimi is decommissioned; it cannot change runtime-owned fallback policy.
O217-4 asks the owner to approve the complete deterministic signing contract, trust root, custody, rotation and revocation behavior, release-origin binding, and redirect allowlist.
O217-5 asks the owner to identify and prove ownership of the exact stale launcher binding and approve its canonical replacement.
O217-6 asks the owner either to remove manifest-expiration enforcement or define the complete signed freshness and trusted-clock policy.
O217-7 asks the owner to require single-file binaries or approve complete per-format archive, inventory, extraction-limit, permission, and filesystem semantics.
